title: Bounds lab: a helper for bce
about: Four loops over buffers. A script finds every bounds check and asks bce what it would do; two UI scripts show the answer as a tile and as marks on the IR and the source.
try: Why does bce keep the check on b.charCodeAt(i) in pairs? Show the branch it would need.
Change window so bce can remove its check, without changing what it returns for k ≤ a.length.
Add a column to the Bounds checks tile with the instructions each check costs in the image.
